# pyvpn

> pyvpn is per-process policy routing for Linux. It sends each app's traffic and DNS out through a chosen, already-existing network interface (wg-jp, tun0, wlan1, ...), with fallback to another interface or the default route, or a kill switch. It does not create or manage VPN connections. Status: alpha (0.0.x); `pyvpn-daemon` routes traffic on Linux, not yet audited. PyPI package: snakevpn. Command and import package: pyvpn. Python >= 3.11, Linux with cgroup v2. License: GPL-3.0-or-later.

`asn:` rules route by an on-disk ASN prefix cache that `pyvpn asn refresh` fills from RIPEstat; the daemon refuses missing or stale (older than 7 days) entries. Some configuration options are not supported yet (target probes, `isolation: netns`); see the usage guide's "Not supported yet" section.
